purpose: lock the current verified synthetic world's behaviour BEFORE any extension, so that any later change to it is detectable. Required by the owner instruction: 'Do not mutate World A until its current behavior is locked.'

WORLD_A.alias: World 0 (the parallel review lane's name for the same object)
WORLD_A.role: linear / common-biology recoverability control and technical-shortcut nuisance rejection

IMMUTABILITY_RULE.statement: World A's generator files are FROZEN. Worlds B, C and D must be implemented as NEW generator files, never as edits or new flags inside these files.
IMMUTABILITY_RULE.why: editing a World A generator would change World A's output bytes even when the new code path is not taken, because the file digest is part of the lock. A new flag is still a mutation.

LOCKED_BEHAVIOURAL_SIGNATURES.note: any future rebuild of World A must reproduce every one of these

LOCKED_ORACLE_CEILINGS.method: linear oracle probe, 50/50 held-out split, seed 20261005, CPM-log1p features
LOCKED_ORACLE_CEILINGS.preserved_because: the owner instruction: 'downstream model performance should be judged as fraction of recoverable truth, not fraction of planted truth'
LOCKED_ORACLE_CEILINGS.headline: a perfect linear reader of the 96-gene view recovers about 0.67 of each shared latent

REPAIR_R1_APPLIED_NOW_AT_THE_METRIC_LEVE.defect: technical_latents[1] and technical_latents[2] are consumed by nothing
REPAIR_R1_APPLIED_NOW_AT_THE_METRIC_LEVE.repair: they are EXCLUDED from every truth-recovery denominator. No generator change is needed and none is made, so World A is not mutated.

WORLD_A_DENOMINATOR_AFTER_REPAIR.rule: fraction-of-recoverable-truth is computed over the 11 biological dimensions, each normalised by its own locked oracle ceiling, never over 14

REPAIR_R2_DEFERRED_TO_WORLD_D_BY_NECESSI.defect: technical_latents[0] and z_reg_private enter ATAC identically; both score 0.000 from RNA and about 0.85 from ATAC, so biological and technical ATAC-private variation are structurally indistinguishable
REPAIR_R2_DEFERRED_TO_WORLD_D_BY_NECESSI.why_it_cannot_be_repaired_in_world_A: the repair requires changing how a factor enters the observation model, which is a generator change. World A is locked, so the repair lands in World D.
REPAIR_R2_DEFERRED_TO_WORLD_D_BY_NECESSI.interim_rule_binding_immediately: until World D exists, NO cross-modal biological-meaning claim may be made from an ATAC-private factor in World A. World A may be used to show that an RNA-non-recoverable factor is not falsely reported as recovered, which does not require distinguishing its biological from its technical origin.
